scope: Gemma 4 BF16 full-model comparisons against pinned Transformers BF16 captures

application.hidden_capture_points: Every selected decoder boundary, including local and global layers and the final pre-norm state
application.logit_positions: Every committed comparison position, not only the final prompt token

reference_variability_diagnostic.admission_use: diagnostic only; the post-freeze measurement does not modify these thresholds
reference_variability_diagnostic.method: Compare the pinned unpadded SDPA reference with alternate Transformers BF16 attention and padding executions, and also record all pairwise variability. This is a finite observed control band for one prompt, not an irreducible numerical floor.

rationale: The limits allow accumulated BF16 reduction-order noise while requiring near-identical vector direction, bounded absolute logit drift, identical greedy decisions, and no non-finite masking. They are frozen before observing Hipfire Gemma 4 whole-model output and may not be weakened after results are seen. Post-freeze reference-variability measurements are retained as diagnostics only.
